import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
entry=Path('experiments/e2e_certificates83_one_update.py')
assert hashlib.sha256(entry.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='bf8850575c39d7df6a9891965fa31a52c83c00ffe9230d5cf0bd49981761ff26'
command=['python3',str(entry),'--population-seconds','900','--train-seconds','1800','--freeze-seconds','120']
body=subprocess.check_output(command)
plan=json.loads(body)
assert plan['not_executed'] is True and plan['same_gpu_job'] is True and plan['critic_offload'] is False
assert plan['wall_seconds_stoploss']==3088 and plan['walltime']=='00:51:28'
out=Path('/scratch/e1583364/cvpr2027/e2e_certificate83_one_update_plan_01.json')
with out.open('xb') as f:f.write(body)
print(json.dumps({'plan_file':str(out),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),'bounds':plan['bounds'],'walltime':plan['walltime'],'not_executed':True,'scope':'Exact reviewable original submit argv; no population freeze, GPU training, or qsub executed'},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
